params.score: segment max CHM, min-max normalized to [0,1] per tile

note: Greedy matching F1 at IoU 0.5, identical harness for all arms. Labels are hand-labeled center+diameter eyeball estimates on leaf-off 2022 8cm ortho; not survey-grade.

method.data_source: NRCan HRDEM Mosaic WCS (https://datacube.services.geo.ca/wrapper/ogc/elevation-hrdem-mosaic), DSM + DTM coverages, Open Government Licence - Canada
method.vintage: 2023 (TRCA GTA_2023 airborne LiDAR ingested into federal mosaic)
method.nominal_resolution: 1 m (WCS serves EPSG:4326 at 1.3216e-05 deg; reprojected to EPSG:3857 at 1.0 m square pixels)
method.fetch_window: lon -79.455..-79.405, lat 43.665..43.69; 16 WCS chunks (4x2 per layer, ~0.0125 deg each); scripts data/lidar/fetch_qa_cover.py, build_qa_chm.py; CHM = DSM - DTM, clipped [-2, 60] m
method.roughness_rule: drop segments with mean local CHM std (5x5 m window) < 0.50 m; additionally drop segments > 400 m^2 with roughness < 0.50; also drop any segment > 120 m^2 (merged house/tree blobs). Thresholds picked by grid search on qa1+qa3 F1; qa7 untouched.
method.box_construction: axis-aligned bbox of the surviving watershed segment, meters from tile top-left (row 0 = tile top)
method.score_definition: segment max CHM, min-max normalized to [0,1] per tile

baselines_for_comparison.note: Identical harness (IoU 0.5, greedy matching, threshold sweep); production GSD for RGB arms.

caveats: CHM is 2023 leaf-on airborne LiDAR at 1 m; labels are hand-labeled center+diameter eyeball estimates on leaf-off 2022 8 cm ortho. qa1/qa3 are dense residential (median labeled-crown max CHM 9 m); qa7 is mature canopy (median 22.4 m).
